title: Michigan fills free college gap, lowers eligibility to 21 — for now
summary_en: Officials are aiming to reach 8,000 residents with the Michigan Reconnect expansion and provide free tuition to young people whose high school education was impacted by the coronavirus pandemic.
author: Kim Kozlowski
title_cn: Michigan fills free college gap, lowers eligibility to 21 — for now

title: Oakland County schools seek new tax to bypass funding limits. Some cry foul
summary_en: Should schools get more money? Voters in Oakland County are deciding whether it’s worth raising taxes to give local districts more money.
author: Isabel Lohman
title_cn: Oakland County schools seek new tax to bypass funding limits. Some cry foul
